snippet.title: Shipolis - Alpha Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4573540/Shipolis

Shipolis is a cozy minimalist city builder and resource management game where you explore unknown archipelagos with a ship and hopes of glory! Sail the seas, develop your cities, grow your population, set up production lines and collect tons of resources. How many great wonders will you build?
